releaseNotes: Adds a shareable error log. Settings now has a Diagnostics section with a Share Error Log button that sends the device's full log to WhatsApp or email, so a problem on a handheld can be diagnosed without having the device in hand. You can also long-press the red upload message on the Registration screen to share it. Also fixes tag uploads failing with 'Each tag must have a valid id': a tag written before its product was synced no longer blocks every later tag from uploading. It repairs itself after Sync Data, and healthy tags now upload past it.
